1.0.0.en: First version: alarm area and zone devices, flow cards, local connection to the ESP32 bridge.

1.0.1.en: New app and device artwork, app description.

1.1.0.en: Bridge connection is set once in the app settings. The bridge is found automatically on your network (mDNS, bridge firmware 1.6.9+).

1.2.0.en: Timeline entries for arming, disarming and alarms, with who did it (panel user, keyswitch, Homey...). Can be switched off in the app settings.

1.3.0.en: New flow card 'Set alarm mode ... as [who]' so the timeline shows which person armed or disarmed (e.g. with the Name tag of a presence trigger).

1.4.0.en: Panel AC power: 'AC power failure' on alarm areas, flow triggers 'lost AC power' / 'AC power restored', condition 'AC power is OK', timeline entries (bridge firmware 1.8.0+).

1.4.2.en: How-to instructions on the app settings page.

1.5.0.en: Panel battery: 'Panel battery low' on alarm areas, flow triggers 'battery became low' / 'battery is OK again', condition 'battery is OK', timeline entries (bridge firmware 1.8.1+).

1.6.0.en: New area setting 'Allow control from the Home alarm tile' (off by default): arm and disarm only with Alarm mode.

1.6.1.en: Timeline: changes made from Homey show 'by Homey' (or the name from the 'as [who]' card) also when the bridge logs in with a user code.

1.6.2.en: Store description: current bridge firmware and unofficial-app note. Works with bridge names that include the IP number (paradox-84.local).
